decisions.reason: The Black Edition was publicly launched as part of the firm's announced black bathroom design concept and was upgraded to its own web page in 2024, so it is visibly committed and fits the design-led direction, making withdrawal unlikely.
CeraFrame Liquid has had a dedicated page since launch and directly supports the announced seamless, barrier-free bathroom strategy, so the investment and public commitment favour keeping it.

The pump-drain shower channel was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, and it continues the earlier pump-assisted effort, so weak early results can still be attributed to ramp-up and management would persist with it.
